name: artcraft_upload_audio
description: Upload a local audio file. Reads a local file and sends it to ArtCraft; requires confirm: true. File must live inside the user's home directory (or ARTCRAFT_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS), be an audio type, and be <= 100 MB.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this local file may be read and uploaded.

file_path.description: Local path to an audio file (mp3/wav/ogg/flac/m4a/aac/opus) inside an allowed directory
